description: This file defines the ClaimExpenseModel class for the OrangeHRM system, used as a data transfer object (DTO) for claim expense entities in the API. It includes OpenAPI annotations for schema generation and implements normalization logic for serializing claim expense data.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseModel
classes.description: A PHP class representing an API model for claim expenses, implementing serialization and normalization for use in API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ClaimExpenseModel with entity data and configures filters and attribute names for serialization.
